name: EACCES
doc: Permission denied. This error is mapped to the exception PermissionError.

name: EAFNOSUPPORT
doc: Address family not supported by protocol

name: EAGAIN
doc: Try again. This error is mapped to the exception BlockingIOError.

name: EALREADY
doc: Operation already in progress. This error is mapped to the exception BlockingIOError.

name: ECHILD
doc: No child processes. This error is mapped to the exception ChildProcessError.

name: ECONNABORTED
doc: Software caused connection abort. This error is mapped to the exception ConnectionAbortedError.

name: ECONNREFUSED
doc: Connection refused. This error is mapped to the exception ConnectionRefusedError.

name: ECONNRESET
doc: Connection reset by peer. This error is mapped to the exception ConnectionResetError.

name: EDOM
doc: Math argument out of domain of func

name: EEXIST
doc: File exists. This error is mapped to the exception FileExistsError.

name: EINPROGRESS
doc: Operation now in progress. This error is mapped to the exception BlockingIOError.

name: EINTR
doc: Interrupted system call. This error is mapped to the exception InterruptedError.

name: EISDIR
doc: Is a directory. This error is mapped to the exception IsADirectoryError.

name: ELIBACC
doc: Can not access a needed shared library

name: ELIBEXEC
doc: Cannot exec a shared library directly

name: ELIBMAX
doc: Attempting to link in too many shared libraries

name: ENETRESET
doc: Network dropped connection because of reset

name: ENOENT
doc: No such file or directory. This error is mapped to the exception FileNotFoundError.

name: ENONET
doc: Machine is not on the network

name: ENOTCAPABLE
doc: Capabilities insufficient. This error is mapped to the exception PermissionError.

name: ENOTDIR
doc: Not a directory. This error is mapped to the exception NotADirectoryError.

name: ENOTNAM
doc: Not a XENIX named type file

name: EOPNOTSUPP
doc: Operation not supported on transport endpoint

name: EOVERFLOW
doc: Value too large for defined data type

name: EPERM
doc: Operation not permitted. This error is mapped to the exception PermissionError.

name: EPIPE
doc: Broken pipe. This error is mapped to the exception BrokenPipeError.

name: ERESTART
doc: Interrupted system call should be restarted

name: ERFKILL
doc: Operation not possible due to RF-kill

name: errorcode
doc: Dictionary providing a mapping from the errno value to the string name in the underlying system. For instance, errno.errorcode[errno.EPERM] maps to 'EPERM'.

name: ESHUTDOWN
doc: Cannot send after transport endpoint shutdown. This error is mapped to the exception BrokenPipeError.

name: ESRCH
doc: No such process. This error is mapped to the exception ProcessLookupError.

name: ETIMEDOUT
doc: Connection timed out. This error is mapped to the exception TimeoutError.

name: EWOULDBLOCK
doc: Operation would block. This error is mapped to the exception BlockingIOError.
